_about: Honors S652 dry-run plan: delete the two automerge-v1 rows HUMA M10ME and LIBR M10CJ merge_into their bases. Written by kb/_honors_two_row_delete_s652.py --plan; nothing applied.

ruling.title: Delete two bot rows so two Honors courses stand apart

why_no_insert: each Honors course's own record already exists as a stand-alone record in kb/coci_minted_singletons.json; with the bot's row gone nothing folds it, nothing points into it and no CN: row re-homes it, so the export emits it as its own row.

alias_chain.effect: none: no map renames any of the four ids, no map is pending, and a delete re-keys nothing; supabase-rekey.yml has no row left to carry for the two leaves

identities_map.why: None of the four ids carries an articulation record, so none needs an identities entry and the rollup's adopter and potential lists stay empty on all four; a later rebuild has nothing to fill for them.

simulated.what: simulated, not applied: export_unified_courses() through its UC_KB_DIR / UC_OUT_DIR seam on kb/ and on a symlink copy of kb/ whose overlay lacks the two entries, in the same session

not_covered: The base titles keep '(Honors)': HUMA M1110's unified_title 'World Religions (Honors)' (trailcrew-ccr3-s112 bot) and LIBR M1040's 'Media & Information Literacy (Honors)' (the same June auto-merge cohort). Changing either is an UPDATE or DELETE of a saved row that card 2 does not name.

HUMA M10ME returns with a discipline inferred from its TOP division (Humanities, dconf 0.4), shown with the inferred mark and held out of the SUBJ4 fold; its base HUMA M1110 carries Religious Studies from a curated row.
The two ids are the records' existing ids (HUMA M10ME, LIBR M10CJ), not the base-plus-H numbers card 3 rules for a new Honors M-ID; whether card 3 renames them is the Honors design's call.

The nightly suggested-merge worklist proposes each pair again (LIBR M1040 with LIBR M10CJ, score 0.84; HUMA M1110 with HUMA M10ME and HUMA M10OI, 0.527). No procedure acts on it; a curator's merge would fold them back until honors_of exists.
